description: For a client, an auditor or a later buyer who holds an Aidoptio evaluation report. Give the report number and the method hash printed in it; the tool reads the public, append-only method log, verifies the whole hash chain and answers: match, match_superseded (a logged deviation replaced the hash), hash_mismatch or unknown_report, with the freeze date, whether the first vendor run came after the freeze, the deviations and the disclosure logged with the report. Read-only; nothing is stored.

method_hash.description: SHA-256 method hash from the report: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

name: verify_report
title: Verify an Aidoptio evaluation report
